name: 06_etf_frequent_retrain

dataset.split: quota stratified by target distribution plus high-variance feature quantile bins

business_question: For a price model retrained every session under drift, which program minimizes error plus training time?

seeds.source: step-60000 neural policy (Rust/Candle CPU), produced by agy_resource_fitness; see seeds.provenance.json

calibration.rules: limits = median calibration reading (2 s.f.); composite resource scale = median reading, accuracy scale = train target sigma; prices = share x median error / median reading

why: Under drift a price model is refitted every session. Training time is a recurring cost, priced per second in a composite with scaled RMSE.
caveats: Corpus copy keeps 3 features (Datetime, Volume, Dividends); OHLC were dropped at ingest.

LEAKAGE RISK (identified 2026-11-03 during the comparison): 3 features dominated by the Datetime column, with random-fold validation and a target-stratified (non-chronological) test split. A kernel smoother over the date can interpolate between neighbouring days, so a large accuracy advantage over tree ensembles here measures interpolation in time, NOT forecasting skill. Treat accuracy results on this case as non-evidence for forecasting until a chronological split is used.
Time-ordered data, but jope pipeline run validates on an unordered fold partition of train.csv, so this case does not exercise chronological (regime) validation
comparability: Composite price from the calibration rule; see the break-even price
Time dominates (3 features): random-fold accuracy measures interpolation in time
